headline: What Does Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) Global AI Push Mean For Investors?
summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions (NasdaqGS:CTSH) launched a dedicated EMEA AI Unit to support enterprise AI deployment across the region. The company entered a partnership with Gulf Edge in Thailand to accelerate adoption of AI solutions for local enterprises. Cognizant signed a five year agreement with The Andover Companies focused on AI driven modernization of core insurance operations.
